newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling holds steady against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling holds steady against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling was flat against the dollar on Tuesday in calm trade, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean of 56.16 against the dollar, unchanged from Monday. On the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean of 87.41 from 87.35 on Monday.

"The market opened unchanged from the previous week's close as players matched their positions in-house," a dealers said. "The dollar has traded within the range of 56.10/25 with the 56 level still proving hard to break."
A commercial banker said "Today should see significant movements as the market anticipates forex inflow both from the tea and coffee sector."
Another dealer said "In the near-term, the market remains directionless, with no major movements anticipated unless the 56 level is broken."
Dealers said the overnight money market was tight. Rates rose above 20 percent.
